title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase is edging down. Kula Ag had mostly shade over the last hour; cloud reaches all the way to the Summit. Upslope has run since about 08:15 at a light 2 mph, and thermals seem flat. Trades are holding the shear line crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio, with no trade air on the lower west slope.
